newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends firmer, locals cover shorts.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends firmer, locals cover shorts.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures lept higher near the close, buoyed by local short-covering and commission house buying, trading sources said.

While the settlement near the day's highs for the second consecutive session was viewed as a positive technical signal by analysts, they said that trade scale-up selling is likely to limit gains and keep prices confined to their current trading range.
Resistance in May was pegged between 10.95-11.00, while nearby support was seen at 10.85 cents.
May closed up 0.02 at 10.92 cents per lb, having ranged from 10.94 to 10.82 cents. The back months finished 0.02 and 0.04 cent higher.
Volume was estimated at 9,798 lots compared with Friday's official 10,567 lots.
Steady but light selling in the May/July spread from the upper 0.20-cent-a-lb range was also noted.
Market sources said the the long-term trend remains to the downside based on ample world supplies. Firm support was pegged at 10.50 cents in May.
